proText: On the Free plan, synthesis and actions work in the first 5 projects you created. This project's meetings stay here as usual.
noSynth: This project doesn't have a synthesis yet. Click Rebuild from scratch so Claude writes the first one from the summaries.
noSynthNoSummary: The synthesis shows up here once the project has meetings with a summary. Move meetings here from the note itself.

pendingBanner.one: {count} meeting isn't in the synthesis yet.
pendingBanner.other: {count} meetings aren't in the synthesis yet.

empty: No meetings in this project yet.
upToDate: The synthesis already includes every meeting with a summary.
rebuilding: Rebuilding the synthesis from scratch with Claude…
kindGroupHint: Groups sub-projects. Has no meetings of its own.
kindSubHint: Has meetings, a synthesis and actions.
noParentYet: Create a project first to put sub-projects inside it.
deleteEmpty: It is empty: no meetings will be affected.
deleteMove: Move the meetings to “No project” and delete the sub-project
deleteMoveGroup: Move the meetings to “No project” and delete the project and its sub-projects
deleteTrashHint: The files go to the Trash and can be recovered.
deleteBusy: You can’t delete this now: a recording or processing in progress uses this project. Stop the recording and wait for processing to finish.
deleteConfirmMismatch: The name you typed doesn’t match. Type the exact name to delete everything.

deletedMoved.one: “{name}” was moved to the Trash; {count} meeting is now in “No project”.
deletedMoved.other: “{name}” was moved to the Trash; {count} meetings are now in “No project”.
